corrections.evidence: Jazz (2008-2015) 1.2 i-VTEC listed as 90 PS (66 kW, 1198 cm3); Autobild generation-3 page: Motoren 1,2-1,4 l Benziner (90-100 PS).
Jazz Van 2008-2015 '1.4 i-VTEC (100 PS)'; Autobild gen-3 page gives range 90-100 PS. Some sources say 73 kW/99 PS - 100 PS is the German-market figure.

Motor1 on the 2011 facelift prices: Hybrid 300 bis 1.323 Liter, 'das konventionell angetriebene Modell bietet 375 bis 1.371 Liter' (battery under the floor). So conventional facelift petrol models = 375 l, same as the 1.2; ADAC's 428 l is an outlier (probably incl. underfloor box). Note Autobild 2011 gives 399-1384 l (incl. underfloor). Not a manufacturer document, so medium certainty.

'3,894 mm in length, 1,752 mm in width (without mirrors) and 1,512 mm in height, wheelbase 2,538 mm'. Honda's press release (hondanews.eu/eu/en/cars/media/pressreleases/181246) says the side cameras sit within the vehicle's body width, so 1752 mm is the width both with and without the camera mirrors.

Honda confirmed to electrive.net in Nov 2023 that it had stopped selling the Honda e in Europe (no longer orderable); Honda Japan: production ended January 2024. Only 101 German registrations in 2023. Last German model year is 2023; 2024 is defensible only if you count the end of production rather than European sales.

Report on the facelifted Jazz Crosstar e:HEV: boot 'atteint 304 litres (sièges arrière relevés méthode VDA)', 1 205 litres seats folded (VDA). Pre-facelift ADAC/Rheinpfalz gave 298 l. Secondary source (no Honda document found), medium certainty.
Same source: '1 205 litres (méthode VDA)' with rear seats folded to the roof. Medium certainty (alternative 1199 l from pre-facelift ADAC).

No dimension change found, but the Elegance trim may be worth adding as a variant. yearTo null (still on sale) confirmed.

Only Jazz and Honda e are covered. Other German-market Honda models from 2005 to 2026 are missing if this file is meant to cover the whole brand: Civic (incl. Type R, e:HEV), CR-V (incl. e:PHEV), HR-V (incl. e:HEV), ZR-V, e:Ny1, Insight, CR-Z, Accord (incl. Tourer), FR-V, Legend, S2000.

verification.notes: 15 WebSearch calls used. Confirmed: GD facelift 3845x1675x1525, 380/1323 l, ES Sport 3855 (fastcarcheck, autobild); GE 3900x1695x1525, WB 2495, 375 l (motor1, mobile.de, angurten), Hybrid 98 PS (auto-news/ecomento), 2008-2015; GK 1694 width, WB 2530, 354 l, 3995 length (carsales/cars-data); facelift early 2018, 1.5 130 PS Dynamic (autonotizen), UK-spec length 4028; GR 4044x1694x1526, 304/1205 l (motor1, Honda UK); GR facelift 4089/1694/1526, 304/1205/844 l (Honda UK); Honda e 3894/1512/2538, 171/861 l. Still unresolved: (1) GE trunkFoldedL 1341 (ADAC) vs 1371 (motor1 2011) vs 1384 (Autobild 2011) vs 1320 (UK data). Not corrected because no source clearly prevails; 1371 is the figure tied to 375 l in the same Honda-based price report. (2) GE Hybrid trunk 303 vs 300 l (motor1); folded 1323 l per motor1. (3) GK Facelift 1.5 Dynamic length 4051: no source found; press kit 3995 vs ADAC/UK 4028 unresolved. (4) GR wheelbase 2517 only confirmed via ADAC/Honda for the facelift, not for 2020 (some sources give 2531 for other markets). (5) GE 1.4 trunkL correction is based on motor1, not on a manufacturer document.
